summary: Tested the bug fix for 'stuck on Resumo Diário' and the full Daily AI Summary feature. BUG FIXED: when logged out, the root URL and the /daily deep link both redirect to /login (login-screen). With the auth token set, the app lands on markets-screen at startup and after reload, never on daily-screen. Navigation to daily-screen works from all 4 entry points (Home open-daily-button, Ferramentas tool-daily, /bot bot-open-daily, /hfx-bot hfx-bot-open-daily), and daily-back-button returns to the screen it came from. Opening the /daily deep link with no history and tapping back goes to the markets tab. Daily screen: 7 day chips, stats cards with correct seeded values (HFX -$4,50 6 ops 50%, bot -$2,50 3 ops 67%, total -$7,00). The generate button streams text (visible within 4s, about 1.8k chars, includes 'Ajustes para amanhã'). daily-history-<UTC date> appears after generation and the button label changes to 'Gerar de novo'. On a day with no trades the button is disabled (aria-disabled=true) and the 'não fecharam operações' message shows. Tapping a history entry reloads the saved text. Backend: test_iter8_daily_summary.py passes 16/16 when run serially. Regression: iter6 (13/13, after a stale-seed fix) and iter7 AI features pass. /bot, /hfx-bot and /analysis load, and Coach IA text renders.

minor.issue: pytest.ini enables xdist (-n --dist loadscope). Run that way, test_iter8_daily_summary.py and test_iter6 seed the shared DB at the same time, which double-counts trades (12 vs 6) and causes false failures. Run with -n 0 for these DB-seeding suites.

issues: At 375px the title 'Mercados' wraps mid-word to 'Mercad / os' and the subtitle wraps onto 3 lines. The new open-daily-button (a third 44px header button, next to the wide 'Ferramentas' button) leaves too little width for the title. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:31-45. Options: make Ferramentas icon-only on narrow screens, put the buttons on their own row, or add numberOfLines={1}/adjustsFontSizeToFit to the title.
Minor: the day chips and server date use UTC, so for users in UTC-3 (Brazil) 'Hoje' moves to the next day after 21:00 local time. This matches the spec (server is UTC) but may confuse users.

action_items: Fix the Markets header title wrapping ('Mercad/os') at 375px width caused by the added open-daily-button (app/(tabs)/index.tsx).
Optional: set addopts so DB-seeding suites run with -n 0, or mark them xdist_group, to avoid parallel seed collisions.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx: 'daily' is now inside Stack.Protected guard={!!user}. This is the correct fix and is verified.
daily.tsx: the back button falls back to router.replace('/') when canGoBack() is false. This is good and is verified on the deep link.
daily.tsx is 205 lines, uses testIDs, and handles loading, empty and error states (toast on error). No deprecated expo packages.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_loss_analysis.py (stale seed: bot-scope HFX analysis is limited to the last 24h, so seed days_ago changed 2 -> 0.01)

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 daily + 13/13 iter6 + iter7 passing when run serially)

seed_data_creation: Used manual_seed_daily.py to seed today and yesterday for user_test1. All TEST_daily hfx_trades/positions and daily_summaries were cleaned afterwards (verified 0 remaining).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run DB-seeding suites with `pytest -n 0`. Use `python tests/manual_seed_daily.py seed|clean` for daily UI testing. Day chip testIDs are daily-day-YYYY-MM-DD. LLM streaming starts within about 4s and finishes in under 30s.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: app/daily.tsx was not registered in Stack.Protected, so expo-router treated it as an unguarded route. Fix verified: logged-out users go to /login, logged-in users start on markets-screen, and back works from every entry point.
